meta.source: Extracted game data, AoM Retold build 19.17020 (Data.bar: gameplay/proto.xml, techtree.xml, major_gods.xml)
meta.note: Start (major_gods.xml): 200 Food, 100 Wood, 50 Gold, 0 Favor; 3 Laborers + 1 Priest (+1 Baboon of Set for Set); the Pharaoh is spawned at the TC immediately by tech PharaohFirstSpawn; TC auto-queues Laborers. Laborer train 17s. PHARAOH EMPOWER (not expressible as modifiers): an empowered building gets x1.75 build rate, research rate and military train rate, x1.2 Favor (Monuments) and x1.2 DropsiteRate (resources dropped there +20%); Ra's Priests and Pharaoh-empowered Monuments (aura 30) empower at x1.45 / x1.12. Most Egyptian buildings cost Gold or are free (House, Granary, Mining Camp, Lumber Camp, Market, Armory); Laborers build at 0.75 speed (buildTime values include it). Heroic Age: free Leviathan at a Dock; Mythic Age: free War Turtle at a Dock. Classical age-up removes the TC build limit.
